data.body: 092c (emitter): corrected file_impact to flat fixture_emit.py (evals/ has no fixture_mining/ subpackage, matches 549b). First review-plan BLOCKED (E1/E2/G1G2): plan referenced dataset input/corpus/expect + gold_set fields with NO stated derivation from the manifest, which carries only compact pointers (norm_id/uuid/signals/rank/direction/tier); and the 'no gold_set material' AC was vacuously always-true. Remediated the plan: emitter now DETERMINISTICALLY synthesizes every emitted field from the candidate row (direction->expect/label; id=<prompt_id>-<direction>-<rank>; corpus=const 'rebar'; input=model-free provenance descriptor from criterion/direction/tier/signals/norm_id-or-uuid/rank; gold=one {input,label} per case). Reworded refusal ACs (one-sided OR zero-candidate -> skipped-unbalanced). Authored held-out oracle (test_fixture_emit.py happy-path + test_fixture_emit_heldout.py: balance/gold refusal, per-side rank-order cap, stale removal, byte-identical idempotence, multi-criteria strict-valid). RED confirmed (module absent). Re-running review-plan.
